summary: GSK plc filed a Form 6-K reporting routine share acquisitions by PDMRs under the company's Share Reward Plan. Multiple executives each acquired 12 ordinary shares at £19.6290 per share on July 9, 2026, via partnership and matching shares on the London Stock Exchange. The filing is a standard notification of director/PDMR dealings, not a special situation. No actionable event or strategic catalyst is present.
